violation_type.title: Caregiver Handwashing After Handling or Feeding Animals (26 TAC §747.3211(8))
violation_type.short_title: Caregiver Handwashing After Handling or Feeding Animals
violation_type.typical_finding: After wiping a child's nose, the caregiver did not wash her hands or the child's hands.     This was corrected at the inspection, when the caregiver washed her hands.

finding_variants.text: After wiping a child's nose, the caregiver did not wash her hands or the child's hands.     This was corrected at the inspection, when the caregiver washed her hands.
